tasks.title: Deferred: auto stale-source refresh (~6 months)
tasks.notes: From ADR 001; system tracker only. Not part of the extract minimum.

tasks.title: Footprint overlap check (paths inside a footprint)
tasks.notes: From Q-201. Investigate Q-189 path-in-footprint first, then dry run lists footprint cells on OSM footway/steps/cycleway or open lidar columns, plus aerial ground share. Done: that footprint reports path cells; test with synthetic footway through a polygon. World Q-203 waits on this with tasks 11–12, 14–15, 17.

tasks.title: Evidence contact sheet in the build run
tasks.notes: From Q-202. One command: portal-facing cameras, top-down over footprint, aerial crop; build records path; handoff end names it and refuses FEATURE without sheet (frontage-and-evidence §4). Done: sheet for a built feature; end refuses missing sheet. World Q-203 waits on this with tasks 11–12 and 14–16.

tasks.title: Catalogue: merge ukdefra-dtm/dsm into ukdefra-lidar + aliases
tasks.notes: Split from old #13. One system provider ukdefra-lidar; aliases for ukdefra-dtm and ukdefra-dsm. google-satellite and google-streetview stay separate. Catalogue JSON remains the index. No providers/ folder move in this ticket.

tasks.title: System providers/<id>/ folders + shims/ + package field
tasks.notes: Split from old #13. Per system provider id under ai-worldbuilder/providers/ (get/review/manage). Old CLIs → shims/ (not scripts/). Cross-provider glue stays in scripts/. package field required when code lives under providers/. reference/ data stays put.

tasks.title: Move local provider tools into world providers/
tasks.notes: Split from old #13. Local providers under southampton-build/providers/; local catalogue package field when code lives there. Can proceed in parallel with #20 once #19 is done.

tasks.title: Loaders/skills/docs resolve system and world provider roots
tasks.notes: Split from old #13. cell_sources, evaluate/add-data-source, AGENTS, SOURCES pointers resolve both ai-worldbuilder/providers/ and active-world providers/.

tasks.title: Rules/OS stale Geocraft-ref sweep
tasks.notes: After #18 move and #23–24 behaviour/evidence changes: grep-driven pass over rules/ (including relocated OS docs) — remove/replace Geocraft-default, lump, and pristine-as-lidar wording. Docs/pointers only unless a leftover clearly contradicts #23–24.

tasks.title: Lidar ghost tool: DTM ground + grey DSM−DTM features
tasks.notes: Idempotent ghost apply (no per-cell .py): DEFRA composite DTM → ghost ground; composite last-return DSM − DTM → grey ghost features. Owners e.g. ghost_<tx>_<tz>_ground / _features; STAGES distinguishes ghost vs real. No trees/decor ghosts in v1. Neighbour ring depth configurable (default 1). CLI for dry run/tests. Real refine still uses ground_layer, trees_layer, decor_layer, house_build/feature_build to overwrite/refine.

tasks.title: Wire lidar ghosts into cell focus / handoff raise
tasks.notes: On CURRENT-CELL focus (cell_marker --raise / handoff path): for each neighbour within configured ring with no real work started, ensure ghost ground + ghost features exist (idempotent). Calls #26 tool.
